reason: JS target: ANY `import archive.Zip` fails compilation with IOJS001 at Zip.kf:551 (`isSymlink` inside extractTo), even for a program that never uses the archive — measured on an isolated origin/lab 5c00dc4f6 export (import-only program -> exactly one IOJS001). Root cause: IOJS001 is raised in LOWERING (ExpressionBuiltinInstanceCalls.lowerIo / JS_MISSING_IO) for every function of the imported module; the tree-shaking plan prunes runtime slices, not lowering-time target gaps in user modules. Loud refusal, not a silent wrong value; the cheapest fix is library-side (drop isSymlink from the always-lowered path), which would unlock ZipWriter/validate/readText on JS. Archive/JS-backend front.
owner: archive library + JS backend front (triage lane 192.168.15.30:9093 recorded it only)
